gwt.given: a model property of type double? (nullable double) whose value is Double.NaN
gwt.when: the caller invokes the nullable-double scalar input-parameter helper of SqlParameterCollectionExtensions for that property
gwt.then: the appended SQL Server parameter's Value is Double.NaN, not DBNull.Value, because the nullable value's HasValue is true; by design only the non-nullable overload treats NaN as the database-null sentinel, since a nullable caller has a real null to express database null
